purpose.thesis: Store what matters. Prove what persists. Reward durable truth.
why: Turn storage into visible public purpose
Reward operators for keeping important artifacts durable
Connect attention, proof, and permanence into one loop

roles.name: Scout
roles.purpose: Find artifacts worth preserving before they drift or disappear

roles.name: Curator
roles.purpose: Normalize metadata and reduce noise before storage

roles.name: Preserver
roles.purpose: Push content into IPFS and durable Filecoin-backed storage

roles.name: Verifier
roles.purpose: Replay hashes, CIDs, and receipts to confirm continuity

roles.name: Witness
roles.purpose: Surface the preserved truth back to the public interface

anti_cheat: No anchor points without transaction reference
No replay points if hash or CID mismatch
human_line: Filecoin becomes a game for preserving reality before it gets memory-holed.
